question: Which statement accurately reflects how a project's chat history relates to that project's workspace?
options: A) Chat history is automatically discarded at the end of every chat session within a project
B) Each project is a self-contained workspace that maintains its own chat history apart from other projects
C) Chat history is stored globally across the account and is identical no matter which project it belongs to
D) Chat history can only be viewed after re-uploading it to the project's knowledge base first
correct_answers: B) Each project is a self-contained workspace that maintains its own chat history apart from other projects
explanations: Incorrect. Chat history is retained as part of the project workspace, not discarded automatically at session end.
Correct. Projects function as self-contained workspaces, each maintaining its own separate chat history and knowledge base distinct from other projects.
Incorrect. Chat history is scoped per project rather than merged into one identical global history across all projects.
Incorrect. Chat history is viewable directly within the project without needing to be uploaded to the knowledge base.
